headline: SFG @ CHC matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is SFG 5.80 at CHC 4.79, with a projected total of 10.59. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward SFG: SFG moved +1.58 runs while CHC moved +0.81, changing the projected margin by +0.77 runs. The projected total climbed +2.38, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -6.9%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Trevor McDonald has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 3.2 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Jung Hoo Lee, Pete Crow-Armstrong, Bryce Eldridge, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Buddy Kennedy, Kevin Alcántara because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
